activeSlice.scope: Add one release-pinned read-only Hunter V1 control capacity check on a persisted Hunter-ready Brand. Report bounded dependency and rate-limit diagnostics, then clear its startup flag. Do not run the 3x3 benchmark or change V1/V2 production routing or rollout thresholds.
successCriteria: Exactly one persisted Hunter-ready V1 control is executed read-only with no control-level retry.
The check reports comparability and allowlisted 429 hints without raw provider data or Brand details.
No quality-delta, retrieval, failure, latency, cost, exploration or topic-share rollout threshold changes.
V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass. Keep benchmark startup flags clear before and after the single check.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The small direct Groq diagnostic succeeded (234 input and 61 output tokens; $0.0000717), but it does not establish that the larger V1 Hunter request fits provider capacity. Startup flags were cleared and the clean deploy is live.
